id: title:dmarticus:hide the keyboard when the drawer opens or the screen changes

review.posthog_relevance: Desktop and mobile web application user experience, specifically preventing keyboard overlap and focus loss when the navigation drawer opens.
review.reason: The observed hunk P1.F1.H1 adds a React effect and screen listener to dismiss the keyboard when the drawer opens and explicitly dismisses the keyboard on drawer blur. This is a localized, bounded behavior correction and UX improvement.

observations.behavior: Adds a React effect and screen listener to dismiss the keyboard when the drawer opens, and explicitly dismisses keyboard on drawer blur.
observations.posthog_connection: This could prevent keyboard overlap or retain focus issues in the mobile desktop app drawer, potentially improving UX for users interacting with the drawer and its content.
